verdict.rationale: Atlassian's docs describe breaking big ideas into actionable tasks and assigning them to the right person (jira-docs-10, jira-docs-23). Community users confirm they create tickets and reassign them to teammates such as QA (jira-comm-7, jira-comm-11), though one notes an issue can have only a single assignee (jira-comm-2). Due dates are only implied by the timeline and calendar views (jira-docs-11), not documented explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of due-date fields on tasks, in-depth first-party docs on task creation and assignment, support for multiple assignees.
